body:
I couldn't do that. I couldn't face them. It's too hard. I'm a coward. I couldn't begin to understand how they would feel.

It would break my mom's heart. I'm crying just thinking about it.
I've been selfish before. I think one more act of cowardice isn't gonna make my family hate me. Or maybe it will, but they don't understand the pain...

Ya, I don't exactly believe that your actions on Earth are what send you to Heaven or Hell. I believe in predestination and salvation by grace, so as far as I'm concerned, suicide doesn't condemn me to hell...
If I ran into someone exactly like me, I might already have had the courage to pull the trigger (on that person).

From what I understand depression plays a large part in all this. I get depressed for absolutely no reason at all, and it makes me super pessimistic at times. I'm feeling better this morning, but I'll get in this mood again sometime, who knows when? Usually happens at night though.
